messages:
marta: Spinning up the eu-west-3 project/account + VPC for the new cluster. Need a minimal, validated checklist for cloud account setup, VPC/VNet scaffolding, quotas (esp GPU), and handoff steps. Draft below — please review and call ownership.

 tian: Ack. Will add GPU quota request and validation steps. Naming conv? CIDR?

 marta: Proposal: project id redwood-eu3-prod, billing under infra-prod. CIDR: 10.40.0.0/16 reserved for region. Subnets: 10.40.1.0/24 control-plane, 10.40.2.0/24 workers, 10.40.3.0/24 bastion. Tags: redwood:env=prod, redwood:region=eu-west-3, redwood:cluster=eu3-01. Use shared VPC peering to prod-net.

 jordan: +1. Terraform module snippet (draft):

 ```hcl
 terraform { required_version = ">= 1.3" }
 module "vpc" {
   source = "git::ssh://git@repo/infra/vpc.git//modules/vpc"
   name   = "redwood-eu3-vpc"
   cidr   = "10.40.0.0/16"
   subnets = { control = "10.40.1.0/24" workers = "10.40.2.0/24" bastion = "10.40.3.0/24" }
   enable_flow_logs = true
   tags = { "redwood:env" = "prod" "redwood:region" = "eu-west-3" }
 }
 ```

 jordan: I'll own the apply once tfplan is green.

 ops-bot: quota-bot: GPU quota request opened (case #INC-4521) for +8 A100 equivalents in eu-west-3.

 tian: Validation notes to include: enable VPC flow logs, reserve static IPs for LB/NAT, create private DNS zones for cluster internal names, ensure MTU settings for cross-region VPN, and enable route propagation for peering. Also confirm cloud NAT and IP masquerade rules.

 marta: Validation checklist (pre-handoff) — assign owners:
 1) Project + billing linked, export billing dataset configured (owner: marta)
 2) IAM: service accounts created for redwood-platform, node-manager, image-puller; roles: compute.admin (scoped), iam.serviceAccountUser, storage.objectAdmin (owner: jordan)
 3) KMS: key created in region, rotation enabled, policy allows redwood-platform SA (owner: marta)
 4) VPC: subnets created, flow logs enabled, peering to prod-net validated (owner: jordan)
 5) Network: BGP/VPN routes, firewall rules for control plane and metric egress (owner: tian)
 6) Quotas: GPU quota approved (owner: tian)
 7) Terraform plan shows no unexpected changes; state locked in remote backend (owner: jordan)
 8) SSH access: bastion SSM doc + ops keyring updated (owner: marta)

 marcus: Cost note: initial Dedicated plan estimate for 8 A100s + infra ~ $3,200/month (ballpark). Recommend evaluating partial spot/ephemeral pool for batch. Add budget alert and tagging to track.

 jordan: After apply, run these smoke checks: kube nodes join, pods pull images from registry, GPU drivers installed, simple perf test model load + one inference. I'll add a small script.

 tian: I ran quick prechecks in the console: VPC created, subnets present, NAT gateway up. Still waiting on GPU quota approval. I documented route table and firewall rules in the runbook draft.

 ops-bot: quota-bot: GPU quota approved by provider. Case #INC-4521 closed.

 marta: Handoff plan: create INFRA ticket with links to tf state, runbook, and confluence. Assign platform-oncall for 48h post-launch. Key handoff items: SA keys in vault, KMS ARN + policy, bastion SSM doc, smoke test runbook, cost dashboard link. Confluence draft: https://confluence.company.internal/infra/eu3-onboard (will publish). @sre-oncall please confirm smoke test window. :white_check_mark:

 sre-oncall: Scheduling smoke tests within 2 hours of apply: node readiness, kube-system pods healthy, model-serving can pull a small image, run 10 short inferences to check latency and correctness. Target p50 <250ms for small model.

 marta: Perfect. I'll update the runbook with the checklist above and close this thread after confluence + INFRA ticket exist. Thanks all. :rocket:
